Name: (DGA) Asters Buildable Kitchen
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Buildable kitchen you can put anywhere
Description:
Buildable kitchen you can put anywhere
Receive a free kitchen set in the mail after upgrading your house, if you haven't upgraded your house yet you can buy a cooker at Robin's shop.
Simple installation, just unzip into your mods folder, no additional configuration required.

This mod is part of my "modular Big Interior Mod" series﻿, other parts include:
[Asters Beam Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11597) and my various furniture mods which can be found [on my profile
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/71424903?tab=user+files)(update: I've now released [all my furniture packs in a single AT conversion](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240)﻿, with searchable keywords!)﻿

I have a [kofi page](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart)﻿﻿ if you'd like to imagine me hopping around like an energizer bunny who's had their morning coffee, or would like to commission some art

_Quick start_

1.  Decide if you want the extra colour choices you get if you download the optional '(AT) Asters Build A Kitchen' file, and download it if you do

2.  Download and extract '(DGA) Asters Build A Kitchen' in the files tab on this mod page and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)﻿).

3.  It's ready to play. You can buy the kitchen at Robin's, but if you upgrade your house you'll also get it for via via the Mail Framework file already included in '(DGA) Asters Build A Kitchen'. And to recolour kitchen pieces you'll need the paint bucket tool, which can also be bought at Robin's.
_Available Expansion packs for this mod
_To retexture the kitchen you need (AT) expansion packs, here's a page with a [video on how to use AT](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OzCzEppsXVY)﻿ in-game.

1.  In the "optional files" of this mod there is an expansion using art from Asters Beam Mod.

2.  Check the optional files for [(AT) Lumisteria's Build A Kitchen](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11803?tab=files).﻿
_On removing the kitchen and using this mod with modded farmhouses:_
You can use this mod with [[CP] No Built In Kitchen](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12120/) to patch over the original kitchen so it's an empty room.

_Compatibility_

*   Mods using the DGA (Dynamic Game Assets) and AT (Alternative Textures) frameworks are generally compatible with most other mods
_For mod authors_

*   You're welcome to create extra AT packs to retexture the original kitchen, the more the merrier
